mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three months signals monetary tightening, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in periods of FEDFUNDS increases, or the rate rise is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL index crosses above 5.0 in a monthly period, it signals accelerating inflation, prompting central banks to tighten policy and dampening equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 5.0 in a month
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-negative despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 5.0, or the inflation spike is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) by over 5% in a month signals robust economic growth, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase by >5% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both proxies rising, or the growth is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) rising by over 0.4 percentage points in a month signals labor market weakening, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE exceeding 0.4pp, or the rise is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Both PAYEMS (employment) and UNRATE (unemployment) increasing by over 5% in a month indicate a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both PAYEMS and UNRATE increase by >5% in a month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both proxies rising, or the growth is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in the federal funds rate followed by an increase in GDPC1 (demand) signals monetary easing and economic momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in late-cycle periods despite the rate decline and demand rise, or the combination is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening labor market (high UNRATE), a drop in UNRATE by 0.2 percentage points signals improving labor conditions, boosting investor sentiment and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns remain non-positive despite UNRATE declining in a tightening labor market, or the decline is not significant.

mechanism_narrative: When the INDPRO supply index drops below 100, it indicates a supply shock, reducing production capacity and driving up prices, which compresses corporate margins and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite INDPRO falling below 100, or the drop is not sustained.
